posts.text: I stopped calling it “procrastination.” Now I call it “creative buffering.”
ADHD guilt hits hardest when you finally have energy… just not for what’s due.
ADHD in women: perfectionism on the outside, panic on the inside.
ADHD be like: Suddenly doing everything at 2am like a raccoon on a mission
It’s for high achievers who’ve spent years thinking they were just lazy, moody, or unmotivated when it was ADHD the whole time
The ADHD urge makes me build systems for systems but somehow, I still pull it off.
